refuter_findings.evidence: The Definition allows any positive C3 H and says “choose the time orientation whose future cone contains N_H” without specifying a global time-orientation structure or its regularity. The pointwise definition in def-time-orientation-and-future-causal-sets defines an orientation of a Lorentz vector space as a choice of one of the two components of {v:g(v,v)<0}; it does not specify the global selection. The global definition in def-gr-smooth-lorentzian-objects requires a smooth Lorentzian metric and smooth timelike vector field, which this C3 data need not provide (for example, H=2+|x^1|^{7/2} is positive C3 but not C-infinity). The later lemma's step 2.1 invokes the orientation specified in [F1] to call n future-directed; it does not define the missing global structure.
